import unittest

from solution import select_runtime_commands


class SelectRuntimeCommandsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_filters_enabled_commands_case_insensitively_in_order(self):
        commands = [
            {"command": "python app.py", "runtime": "Python", "enabled": True},
            {"command": "old.py", "runtime": "PYTHON", "enabled": False},
            {"command": "node app.js", "runtime": "node", "enabled": True},
            {"command": "worker.py", "runtime": "pYtHoN", "enabled": True},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            select_runtime_commands(commands, "PYTHON"),
            [commands[0], commands[3]],
        )

    def test_deep_copies_selected_mappings_and_nested_values(self):
        class Text(str):
            pass

        nested_command = Text("run")
        nested_command.metadata = {"flags": ["--safe"]}
        item = {"command": nested_command, "runtime": "py", "enabled": True}
        result = select_runtime_commands([item], "PY")
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], item)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["command"], nested_command)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["command"].metadata, nested_command.metadata)
        result[0]["command"].metadata["flags"].append("--changed")
        self.assertEqual(nested_command.metadata, {"flags": ["--safe"]})

    def test_empty_and_general_iterables(self):
        self.assertEqual(select_runtime_commands([], "py"), [])
        source = (
            {"command": str(i), "runtime": "py", "enabled": True}
            for i in range(2)
        )
        self.assertEqual([x["command"] for x in select_runtime_commands(source, "py")], ["0", "1"])

    def test_runtime_validation(self):
        for runtime, error in [(None, TypeError), (1, TypeError), ("", ValueError)]:
            with self.subTest(runtime=runtime), self.assertRaises(error):
                select_runtime_commands([], runtime)

    def test_commands_and_items_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            select_runtime_commands("commands", "py")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            select_runtime_commands(None, "py")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            select_runtime_commands([1], "py")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_runtime_commands([{"command": "x", "runtime": "py"}], "py")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_runtime_commands([{"command": "x", "runtime": "py", "enabled": True, "extra": 1}], "py")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            select_runtime_commands([{"command": 1, "runtime": "py", "enabled": True}], "py")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            select_runtime_commands([{"command": "", "runtime": "py", "enabled": True}], "py")
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            select_runtime_commands([{"command": "x", "runtime": "py", "enabled": 1}], "py")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
